title: quantityDeclarationResponseTimeSeries
description: Time series for one quantity type in a quantity declaration response. Requested and confirmed quantities are hourly values. Booked capacity is a daily value for the complete calendar day.

quantityType.description: Type of quantity represented by the time series.

x-enumDescriptions.RequestedQuantity: Quantity requested by the Balancing Group Responsible Party.
x-enumDescriptions.ConfirmedQuantity: Quantity confirmed by the Hydrogen Grid Operator after processing the quantity declaration.
x-enumDescriptions.BookedCapacity: Capacity booked for the relevant location and balancing group for the complete calendar day.

granularity.description: Duration of each time-series interval. PT1H represents one hour. P1D represents one complete calendar day.

unit.description: Unit of the time-series values. Quantities are expressed in kWh and booked capacity is expressed in kW.

values.description: Chronologically ordered time-series values. Each value represents the quantity for one interval defined by granularity.

status.description: Processing status of the confirmed quantity.

x-enumDescriptions.requestedQuantityConfirmed: The requested quantity was confirmed by the Hydrogen Grid Operator and can be used as the confirmed quantity for the relevant process.
x-enumDescriptions.capacityExceeded: The requested quantity exceeds the booked or available capacity. The confirmed quantity may therefore be reduced to the applicable capacity limit.
x-enumDescriptions.supplyBottleneck: The quantity was reduced or interrupted because of a supply or network bottleneck. The resulting confirmed quantity must be treated as a dispatch instruction.

dispatchInstruction.description: Indicates whether the confirmed quantity is a binding operational instruction that must be followed by the receiving market participant.
